narrative.headline: Top 50 tilts decisively bullish (29 bullish/lean bullish vs 19 bearish/lean bearish) with mega-cap tech, consumer staples, and payments seeing coordinated call flow plus massive dark pool accumulation — but semis and industrials are being distributed.
bullish_setups: WMT: perfect 10/10/10 sweep — $4M call premium + $702M dark pool signals staples rotation
GOOGL: $14.9M call premium (flow 9.67) + $786M dark pool — highest conviction mega-cap tech setup
AAPL: $49.9M call premium + $1.27B dark pool — largest absolute institutional footprint on the tape
MSFT: $31.2M call premium + $1.37B dark pool accumulation, flow 8.78
AMZN: $27.8M call premium + $975M dark pool confirms mega-cap tech bid
META: $32.2M call premium + $885M dark pool — heavy near-money positioning
NFLX: flow 9.65 with $10.1M premium + $340M dark pool
ABBV/LLY: pharma majors both showing 10/10/10 or near-perfect scores — healthcare mega-cap accumulation
KO/PG/PEP: staples trifecta all scoring 8.9+ — defensive accumulation alongside tech
V/AXP: payments complex bid, AXP flow 10.0
bearish_setups: NVDA: flow 4.15 — puts outpacing calls despite $10 dark pool magnitude; the dark pool conviction is amplifying bearish flow, not saving it
JPM: flow 3.61 — put-heavy on the largest bank, notable divergence from broader bullish tape
BRK.B: flow 0.0 — complete absence of call premium, deepest bearish flow read
CAT/GE/GEV: industrials cluster bearish — flow 2.78/1.41/1.54 signals distribution in the cycle-sensitive names
KLAC/TXN/AMAT: semis ex-NVDA also weak (flow 0.43/0.76/4.88) — broad semiconductor de-risking
JNJ: flow 1.58 — lone pharma laggard against ABBV/LLY strength
narrative.rotation_signal: Institutions are accumulating mega-cap tech (GOOGL/AAPL/MSFT/AMZN/META), staples (WMT/KO/PG/PEP), payments (V/AXP), and select pharma (ABBV/LLY) while distributing semiconductors (NVDA/KLAC/TXN/AMAT), industrials (CAT/GE/GEV), and money-center banks (JPM). This is a classic quality/defensive-plus-mega-tech barbell — smart money is de-risking cyclicals while doubling down on cash-flow compounders.
narrative.diverging_from_industry_layer: NVDA bearish read is the standout — flow 4.15 with $10 dark pool magnitude means the size is confirming put positioning, directly conflicting with the broadly bullish mega-cap tech story (GOOGL/MSFT/AMZN/META all 8.8+). Semis are being singled out. JPM bearish also diverges from the payments (V/AXP) strength, suggesting the negativity is bank-specific, not financials-wide.
